9/11: 25 Years Later

America mourns the landmark anniversary of an attack that forever changed the nation

Ceremonies nationwide will commemorate the 2,977 lives lost in the Sept. 11 attacks, which became the catalyst for the U.S. war on terror.
LIVE
  • Vice President JD Vance arrives at Manhattan ceremony
    Just now1m ago

    Vice President JD Vance was seen at the ceremony greeting former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani, who had been speaking with former NYC Mayor Michael Bloomberg.

  • NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and former Mayor Bill de Blasio attend Manhattan ceremony
    Just now4m ago

    New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani was seen earlier in the crowd at the memorial ceremony talking with former Mayor Bill de Blasio.

  • Barack and Michelle Obama share statement remembering 9/11
    Just now8m ago

    Former President and First Lady Barack and Michelle Obama shared a statement remembering Sept. 11, 2001. The former president is set to appear at the Ground Zero ceremony today.

  • U.S. marking 25 years since 9/11 with ceremonies in New York and Washington
    Just now23m ago

    All four living former U.S. presidents will be at Ground Zero today to honor the lives lost on 9/11 and to remember the tragedy that struck the country 25 years ago. Vice President J.D. Vance will also be at Ground Zero, and President Trump will be marking the anniversary in Washington at the Pentagon.
